items.briefing:
Australian finance teams are being warned about rising payment scams, with fraudsters increasingly targeting staff who process transactions. Scammers are exploiting gaps in verification processes, making it easier to redirect payments to fraudulent accounts. This is a significant risk for registered training organisations that handle enrolment fees, government funding, and supplier payments.

To protect your organisation, always verify payment detail changes by calling the requester directly on a known number — never use contact details provided in the same email requesting the change.

featured.title: Cross-border checkout has a data quality problem
featured.summary: Poor data at checkout is fuelling cost surprises, missed deliveries and fraud fears that are turning many cross-border shoppers away.
